interactions.with: GLOSS.area-of-effect (lines from the origin; Total Cover blocks, R-34)
interactions.note: Any Cylinder would reuse the area-of-effect cover rule from its origin. Nothing in scope creates a Cylinder, so this isn't reachable.

interactions.with: GLOSS.cube / R-35 (point-placed area rests on the ground and extends upward)
interactions.note: Stage A proposes the same bottom-face convention. The 2014 ground-or-effect-height trap is relevant only once a Cylinder creator exists.

interactions.with: GLOSS.sphere / R-32 (grid radius, centre to centre, inclusive)
interactions.note: The base radius would use R-32's metric. A height needs an elevation convention, which the register lacks (stage A gap).

interactions.with: R-33 (origin included, creature on it affected)
interactions.note: This mirrors the Sphere ruling and is the opposite of Cones and Cubes (R-29, R-31).

No in-scope spell or monster has a Cylinder area. Grep of dungdra/ (including data) finds no 'cylinder'. The Cylinder spells (Flame Strike, Ice Storm, Sleet Storm, Call Lightning, Moonbeam, Magic Circle) and the Cloud Giant are all outside §1.1. geometry.in_area has no Cylinder branch, and its single `size` can't carry both a radius and a height.

abuse.case: Hanging a Cylinder's origin in the air or measuring height from the wrong face so a column misses creatures on the ground (new, added to catalogue)
abuse.reason: No in-scope effect creates a Cylinder, so there's no command to abuse.

abuse.case: Naming creatures for an area spell that the area can't hold / leaving creatures in an 'each creature' area off the list
abuse.reason: Applies to Cylinders in principle. No in-scope Cylinder effect exists. Sphere, Cube and Cone already cover this.

abuse.case: Stretching an area with a higher slot
abuse.reason: No in-scope Cylinder spell to upcast.

not_testable.reason: Nothing in the implemented subset creates a Cylinder. None of the 32 in-scope spells has one, and no engine monster has one. The engine has no Cylinder geometry, and a test would have to invent the API for it (geometry.in_area takes one size, so it can't take a radius and a height). Per CLAUDE.md, content the engine doesn't implement gets no tests.

The radius and height come from the creating effect, and no in-scope effect gives one. The threshold (radius boundary, height versus elevation) can't be exercised without a Cylinder creator. Stage A's height and elevation gap needs a ruling before such content is added.
The origin being included can be observed only through an effect that places a Cylinder, and none is in scope.

output.summary: GLOSS.cylinder can't be tested inside the implemented subset. The Rules Glossary is in scope, but none of the 32 in-scope spells and no engine monster creates a Cylinder. There is no 'cylinder' anywhere in dungdra/, and geometry.in_area has no Cylinder shape (its single size parameter couldn't hold both a radius and a height). Writing tests would mean inventing an engine API for content the engine refuses, which CLAUDE.md rules out. So all three clauses are recorded as out-of-scope with no tests. When a Cylinder creator (Flame Strike, Ice Storm, Moonbeam, …) enters scope, its tests should build on stage A's proposed readings: R-32's grid radius, R-35's bottom-face origin with the Cylinder extending up, and R-33's included origin. The height-versus-elevation gap needs a ruling first. I added one cheat to loop/abuse-catalogue.md: an origin hung in the air or a height measured from the wrong face, plus leaving out the creature on the origin. No scenario verdicts needed action; stage B found only unrelated page-180 matches.
